descricao_produto: PRODUCT: a set of exactly three identical tall slim cylindrical spray bottles standing upright side by side in one straight row, evenly spaced, all facing the camera with labels fully visible, always in this fixed order from left to right: ENIGMA (black label), MIDTOWN (silver label), BARBARIUS (navy blue label). Each bottle is about 3.8 times taller than wide and made of clear transparent plastic. Top part: a tall clear transparent cylindrical overcap with a flat top, the same diameter as the bottle, covering the upper third of the bottle; through the clear cap you see a clear transparent spray pump head and, just below it, one shiny polished chrome silver collar ring. Below the cap, a short clear section of the bottle, then a matte wraparound rectangular label covering most of the lower half of the bottle, then a short thick clear transparent base at the bottom. All label text is left-aligned in the middle of the label. LEFT bottle: solid matte black label with small italic white 'bodyman', large white tall serif 'ENIGMA', a thin short white line, a few small white text lines, a white 'PRIMACIAL' wordmark and small white '200 ml'. MIDDLE bottle: brushed metallic silver label with 'body man' in light blue sans-serif on two lines, large black tall condensed serif 'MIDTOWN', a thin short black line, a few small grey text lines, a dark grey 'PRIMACIAL' wordmark and small light blue '200 ml'. RIGHT bottle: deep navy blue label with 'body man' in white sans-serif on two lines, large white tall condensed serif 'BARBARIUS', a thin short white line, a few small white text lines, a white 'PRIMACIAL' wordmark and small white '200 ml'. No other bottles, no boxes, no gift wrap, no extra items. Label lettering stays exactly as in the photo, sharp and never rewritten.
